llvm/llvm-project#177650 (by bassiounix): [libc][math] Refactor `sqrti` to Header Only.
We need to refactor `sqrti` to be header-only, `constexpr` (if possible), shared math function.
We need make sure that the code compiles with the supported compilers and build systems in LLVM libc: `Clang`, `GCC12.2`, `CMake` and `Bazel`.

Part of #147386

in preparation for: <https://discourse.llvm.org/t/rfc-make-clang-builtin-math-functions-constexpr-with-llvm-libc-to-support-c-23-constexpr-math-functions/86450>

It also updates build system metadata (CMake and Bazel) and tests to use the new header-only implementation. **Changes:** - Introduce `libc/src/__support/math/sqrti.h` providing `math::sqrti` and `math::sqrti_fast` as `constexpr` templates backed by `fixed_point::isqrt`/`isqrt_fast`. - Add `libc/shared/math/sqrti.h` and include it from `libc/shared/math.h` to expose `shared::sqrti` / `shared::sqrti_fast`. - Update stdfix entrypoints (`uhksqrtus`, `uksqrtui`), their tests, and CMake/Bazel targets to depend on `math::sqrti` and the new support libraries. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
